rationale: Do not apply the earlier repo-only merge recommendation. Amber's current official case study presents Biddeford Downtown Redevelopment as a distinct operational project, reports 100% equity ownership, an August 2020 financial close and a 25-year term. The City of Biddeford identifies Biddeford RiverWalk Community 1, LLC as the project company that financed and operates the parking system under the long-term arrangement. These current primary sources support a standalone infrastructure-asset boundary rather than a merge into a conceptual Amber-Hunt development platform.
